verdict.rationale: Whether an operating system's source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions source code availability or licensing for macOS; the items cover Continuity features, Siri AI, built-in CLI tools and outages, none of which bear on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
